description: This Java source file defines the LwM2MBootstrapConfig class, which manages configuration for LwM2M bootstrap servers, including security settings and server configurations, for the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: LwM2MBootstrapConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration for LwM2M bootstrap servers, including security credentials and server settings, with methods to generate bootstrap configurations.

methods.name: LwM2MBootstrapConfig
methods.description: Constructor initializing the configuration with server list and credentials.

methods.name: getLwM2MBootstrapConfig
